methodology: One optional restart command, then a cold pass of one call per query plan in matrix order and one call per metadata route, then for each plan and route --warmup discarded calls followed by --runs recorded warm calls. Wall time is time.perf_counter around the HTTP request and body read (loopback, no proxy); server time is execution.elapsed_ms. p50 and p95 are nearest-rank over the sorted warm samples. A call that fails ends the warm loop of its plan and marks the row. Later cold calls may benefit from object-cache fills made by earlier plans of the same pass; the on-disk object cache is emptied only if the restart command does so.
